def regions(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    hsep=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==4 for x in g[r])]
    vsep=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==4 for r in range(h))]
    rh=[0]+[r+1 for r in hsep]; rb=[r-1 for r in hsep]+[h-1]
    # row bands between separators (excluding separator rows)
    bands=[]; prev=-1
    for r in hsep+[h]:
        if r-1>prev: bands.append((prev+1,r-1))
        prev=r
    vbands=[]; prev=-1
    for c in vsep+[w]:
        if c-1>prev: vbands.append((prev+1,c-1))
        prev=c
    return hsep,vsep,bands,vbands

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    hsep,vsep,bands,vbands=regions(g)
    bg=9 if 9 in {x for row in g for x in row} else 5
    # find pattern band: region not all bg
    pat=None
    for (r0,r1) in bands:
        for (c0,c1) in vbands:
            cells=[g[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)]
            if any(x!=bg for x in cells):
                pat=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in g[r0:r1+1]]
    if pat is None: return g
    ph,pw=len(pat),len(pat[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for (r0,r1) in bands:
        for (c0,c1) in vbands:
            if all(g[r][c]==bg for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)) \
               and (r1-r0+1)==ph and (c1-c0+1)==pw:
                for i in range(ph):
                    for j in range(pw):
                        out[r0+i][c0+j]=pat[i][j]
    return out
